title: LIVE Ningbo Open Semi-Finals | Elena Rybakina faces tough test against Diana Shnaider as final lineup set to be confirmed

LIVE Ningbo Open Semi-Finals | Elena Rybakina faces tough test against Diana Shnaider as final lineup set to be confirmed Tournaments ▼ Newsletter FAQ Calendars ▼ Players ▼ Originals ▼ Live Scores LIVE Ningbo Open Semi-Finals | Elena Rybakina faces tough test against Diana Shnaider as final lineup set to be confirmed
 WTA by Lucas Michael Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 11:30 Follow us on Google! 0 We are getting to the climax of the Ningbo Open with the second
semi-final tie putting together two top players. One of which is the reigning champion,
Elena Rybakina. However, she was not totally convincing in her quarter-final
clash against Katarzyna Kawa in a three-set win and could come unstuck with a tougher
opponent on the other side of the net. 2023 finalist Diana Shnaider will hope
to capitalise on this against the World No.1 with a first final in 2026 one win
away. Follow for live updates! ARTICLE_IN_2
